correctness.rationale: The finite-dimensional trace classification follows directly from the presentation. In any finite-dimensional representation, central Z decomposes the space into eigenspaces with Z=μI; on an r-dimensional block UV=μVU, so determinants give μ^r=1. If t is not a root-of-unity trace μ+μ^{-1}, the last relation forces U+V=2I, and the standard positive identity then forces U=V=I; the commutation relation forces μ=1. Conversely, at every cyclotomic t one gets a distinct finite-dimensional trace from clock-shift matrices (or a distinct character at t=2). For |t|>2, z+z*−t is invertible, forcing u=v=z=1. For noncyclotomic t in (−2,2), choosing the corresponding non-root-of-unity ζ gives a quotient onto the irrational rotation algebra and hence a distinct amenable trace. The density assertions are elementary consequences of roots of unity being countable dense on the unit circle. The bundled checker only verifies support counts and finite clock-shift identities; none of these finite checks substitutes for the analytic argument.
